description: Post-distribution Phase 5 gate. WATCH.py scans all published campaigns for missing analytics data (no impressions/reactions/comments/shares recorded after ship). HOW.py warns if a specific campaign is 7+ days post-ship with no analytics. Closes the learning loop: Idea → Ship → Measure → Learn → Next Idea. Also surfaces the campaign.json schema gap (analytics section missing).
litmus: Run WATCH.py — signals 'strengthen' if published campaigns have no analytics data after 7+ days. Run HOW.py per-campaign for pre-distribution analytics reminders.

files.HOW.py: Per-campaign analytics staleness gate — WARN if 7+ days since ship with no analytics
files.AUDIT.py: Cross-campaign audit — surfaces all published campaigns missing analytics data
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — detects analytics gap and schema gap, signals strengthen

schema_gap_note: campaign.json schema does not yet have an 'analytics' section. Add: analytics: {impressions: null, reactions: null, comments: null, shares: null, profile_views_delta: null, updated: null}. This is flagged in AUDIT.py and WATCH.py outputs.
origin: 2026-05-07: Phase 5 (analytics/learn) of the campaign lifecycle has no mechanical gate. WATCH.py built to surface stale campaigns and schema gap.
